title: AndroDash AppConfig
description: Canonical launch configuration (C-001). URL values are runtime-redacted in diagnostics but must still be absolute http(s).

dashboardUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the Perses dashboard JSON. Userinfo is rejected at runtime.

prometheusUrl.description: Optional Prometheus base URL overriding dashboard datasource URLs. Userinfo is rejected at runtime.

refreshSeconds.description: 0 means manual only; null means use the dashboard/default. Values 1-4 are clamped to 5 at runtime.

timeRange.description: Go/Perses-style duration, 1s..30d at runtime; null means dashboard duration or 1h.

stepSeconds.description: Prometheus range step; null means auto (C-003).

debug.description: Enable the diagnostics overlay and debug affordances (C-009).

layoutMode.description: Panel layout (C-005). fit sizes the layout to the viewport (fit-to-screen).

displayMode.description: Presentation mode (C-005). amoled removes gradients on true black; monochrome is the high-contrast black-and-white lock-screen presentation.

lockStyle.description: Renderer colours while the phone is locked with show_when_locked (C-007). monochrome is the grayscale locked view; color keeps the configured display_mode colours. Additive; persisted objects without it default to monochrome.

dashboardSource.description: Where the renderer gets the dashboard JSON (C-001, C-007). stored loads the on-device copy at /stored/<i>/dashboard.json (i = the position of dashboardUrl in dashboardUrls) when that slot's meta sourceUrl equals dashboardUrl, otherwise fetches dashboardUrl and stores the result with AndroDash.storeDashboard; url fetches dashboardUrl on every load and stores nothing. Bundled http://androdash.local/dashboards/ URLs are always local and never stored. Additive; persisted objects without it default to stored.

dashboardUrls.description: Dashboards the renderer can switch between (C-001 dashboard_urls), in order; always contains dashboardUrl. A comma inside a URL is written %2C. The position is also the stored-copy slot (/stored/<i>/). Additive; persisted objects without it default to [dashboardUrl].

rotateSeconds.description: Advance to the next dashboardUrls entry every N seconds; 0 is off. Additive; persisted objects without it default to 0.

dashboardName.description: Selects a dashboard when the URL returns an array (C-002).

capabilities.description: Advertised capability override; null means probe (C-004).

showUnsupported.description: Render explicit placeholders for hidden panels instead of removing them (C-004).

collector.description: Run the bundled Prometheus on the phone (C-001, C-007, decision 0019). When true the shell passes prometheus_url=http://127.0.0.1:19090 to the renderer instead of prometheusUrl. Native-only; not a renderer query parameter. Additive; persisted objects without it default to false.

collectorTargets.description: Canonical collector_targets: 1-32 comma-separated entries [job:]instance=host:port or host:port; job and instance match [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}; host is a DNS name, IPv4, or bracketed IPv6; port 1-65535; job defaults to node, instance to host:port. Required when collector is true and collectorPhone is false; with collectorPhone true no entry may be job phone with instance phone. Native-only.

collectorScrapeSeconds.description: Collector global scrape interval in seconds. Native-only.

collectorRetention.description: Collector TSDB retention, C-001 duration grammar, 1h..30d at runtime. Native-only.

collectorPhone.description: While the collector runs, also run the in-app phone exporter on 127.0.0.1:19100 and scrape it as job phone, instance phone (C-001, C-007, decision 0021). Native-only. Additive; persisted objects without it default to true.
